test_title: PYST 53: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.

The car was repaired by the mechanic.

options.text: The mechanic has repaired the car.
The mechanic is repairing the car.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The subject of the active voice sentence becomes the object of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The car was repaired by the mechanic."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the original subject "the mechanic" at the beginning of the sentence.
 
• Change the passive verb form "was repaired" to "repaired" (simple past active).
 
• Keep the object "the car" after the verb.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The mechanic repaired the car."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The mechanic repairs the car." – Incorrect tense (present simple active).
 
• **Option 2: **"The mechanic has repaired the car." – Incorrect tense (present perfect active).
 
• **Option 3: **"The mechanic is repairing the car." – Incorrect tense (present continuous active).
